overview: FPNet checkpoint full_eval_final.pt (sha256 5b8d1c31...) with its training code (code/), training manifest and records (records/). See README.md.
usage:
# Model Format
PyTorch checkpoint loaded with casmi.fpnet.load_model (casmi package of ahmedberatozer/casmi26-v3-models).

# Training Data
Competition train.parquet only (rows listed in records/dropped_train_rows.json removed; dev2/locked2 identity groups held out).

# Model Inputs
Preprocessed MS/MS spectrum (casmi spectrum cache format).

# Model Outputs
Fingerprint logits over 10,226 bits.

# Model Usage
B1 pipeline: --fpnet_ckpt full_eval_final.pt (https://github.com/Satsuki-Tam/CASMI2026).

# Fine-tuning
Not intended.

# Changelog
2026-10-25 first version.
